categories.title: Self-hosted team credential manager
categories.description: An open-source, self-hostable service or server that stores team credentials (passwords, API keys and secrets) and that password-manager clients can synchronise against. Desktop, mobile and browser client applications and developer libraries are out of scope.

categories.title: Message broker for event streaming
categories.description: An open-source broker for durable, high-throughput event streaming between internal services.

categories.title: Log collection agent
categories.description: An open-source agent that tails application logs and ships them to a central collector.

categories.title: API gateway / edge proxy
categories.description: An open-source reverse proxy that fronts internal HTTP services.
